caption: The drawing features five rectangular and square fabric swatches arranged in a roughly cross-like pattern against a plain, light-beige background. In the center is a larger, off-white or cream-colored fabric with scattered clusters of floral motifs in green, blue, and light brown shades. Surrounding this central piece, four smaller dark brown fabric samples are arranged at the top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right. The top left and bottom left swatches are predominantly dark brown with sparse, small, yellowish-green plant or leaf motifs. The top right swatch is also dark brown, but with a denser scattering of very small, pale green and yellow leaf or sprig motifs. The bottom right swatch is a slightly lighter brown, detailed with a more intricate pattern of grayish, turquoise, and white flowers, together with light brown vine or tendril designs. Each fabric swatch is distinctly bordered against the pale background, and there is no overlapping between them.
title: Materials from Patchwork Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
